subject: Request for access: executive summary & proposed redaction/embargo plan
messages:
From: James Smith <j.smith@acme-analytics.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test executive summary and remediation ETA

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. Acme's InfoSec team asked if we can get the executive summary from your most recent penetration test to complete our SIG questionnaire. They specifically need high-level findings and remediation timelines — we don't need raw logs or full exploit details at this stage.

Two quick asks from our side: 1) a redacted exec summary we can share internally with the procurement team today or tomorrow, and 2) the ETA for when the full report (or an evidence bundle) could be shared under an NDA.

Can you confirm what level of redaction Redwood is comfortable with and whether you require a mutual NDA before sending the sanitized doc? If you prefer, Acme Legal is happy to review/execute a standard mutual NDA — copying them here.

Best,
James
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachment: external-request-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: James Smith <j.smith@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test executive summary and remediation ETA

Hi James — thanks for the clear asks. We can do a two-step exchange to balance Acme's procurement timeline and Redwood's confidentiality needs:

1) Immediate: provide a sanitized executive summary (PDF) that excludes exploit traces, IP addresses, customer-identifying data, and low-level PoC snippets. We can deliver this within 24–48 hours after a brief review by our security team.

2) Follow-up: full report + evidence bundle under a signed mutual NDA and with an agreed limited distribution list. For particularly sensitive findings we request an embargo period (we typically propose 60–90 days) to coordinate fixes; we can be explicit in the NDA about embargo/limited distribution.

I've attached a mutual NDA template (NDA_Mutual_Acme_20270719.docx) and a proposed redaction matrix (redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx) that maps what we redact and why. Lauren — can you confirm we are ok with 60 days embargo for critical issues, 30 for moderate? Jonas — please review the proposed redaction categories.

James — if Acme can sign the NDA and confirm the internal distro list, we will deliver the sanitized executive summary today (as a stub now) and schedule a walkthrough once the NDA is returned.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: exec_summary_sanitized_stub.pdf (stub)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test executive summary and remediation ETA

Agree with Evelyn's flow. Quick notes:
- 60-day embargo for critical findings (those with CVSS >= 8.0 or active exploit chains)
- 30-day for moderate (CVSS 4.0–7.9)
- Low/Informational: immediate disclosure in sanitized form

Redaction matrix: sensitive IDs (customer names, internal hostnames), exploit code, and screenshots of dashboards get redacted. We can include pseudo-code describing the vulnerability without PoC.

Jonas: I'll need a short remediation ledger snippet we can include saying "status: in progress / ETA" for each critical item so Acme sees a concrete plan without sharing raw evidence. Can you pull that into column G of the redaction matrix?

Thanks — Lauren

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test executive summary and remediation ETA

On Thu, Jul 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Agree with Evelyn's flow...

Quick update — I've populated the remediation ledger in redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx with preliminary ETAs: two critical items targeted for mitigation within 45 days, three moderate items within 25 days. For the sanitized exec summary we will add an annotated status column: "Mitigation started (owner, ETA)".

Also recommend we request Acme to sign the mutual NDA and provide the list of recipients (names + roles). We will not send the full report until the mutually agreed embargo/distribution terms are signed.

-Jonas
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: James Smith <j.smith@acme-analytics.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acme-analytics.com>, security@acme-analytics.com, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test executive summary and remediation ETA

Evelyn/Team — thanks, that plan works for us. A few items to close:

- Acme Legal will countersign the mutual NDA; please confirm you accept the mutual template and we'll route via DocuSign (link below).
- We'll provide the recipient distro (names + roles) as requested.
- 60-day embargo for critical items is acceptable; we may request a brief joint statement to our customers after fixes are validated.

Please send the sanitized executive summary as soon as ready. Once NDA is signed we will schedule the evidence review session.

Appreciate the transparency on the remediation ETA — that helps procurement move forward.

Best regards,
James
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Acme-NDA-20270719/abc123
